name: useSend
description: useSend is an open-source email sending platform and self-hosted alternative to Resend, SendGrid or Postmark. It sends transactional email through a REST API, SDKs or SMTP, and marketing campaigns to contact books from a visual editor, with domain verification, delivery, open and click tracking, bounces, suppression lists and webhooks. Delivery runs through Amazon SES. This script builds the web app and the SMTP proxy from source and runs them with PostgreSQL and Redis.

app_vars.name: var_github_id
app_vars.label: GitHub OAuth Client ID
app_vars.help: From a GitHub OAuth app whose callback URL is http://<container IP>:3000/api/auth/callback/github. Leave empty to configure it after the install; useSend starts once it is set.
